summary: All four games tipped at 8 p.m. Eastern. Memphis led Golden State from start to finish in a 126-98 win, and Victor Wembanyama scored 32 as San Antonio beat the Clippers 124-112. The Knicks held on 102-99 in Minnesota after a 19-point lead shrank to three, and Damian Lillard's 33 points led Portland past Milwaukee 124-114.

games.headline: Grizzlies lead all the way in rout of Warriors
games.story: Memphis scored first, never trailed and led 55-47 at halftime before outscoring Golden State 37-26 in the third quarter. The lead reached 34 points at 121-87 with 3:03 left. Jaylen Wells led the Grizzlies with 22 points on 8-of-10 shooting and seven rebounds, Cedric Coward made five 3-pointers for 19 points and Cam Spencer had 11 assists. Charles Bassey had 16 points and 13 rebounds for the Warriors, who were without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III, Draymond Green and Kristaps Porzingis.

games.headline: Lillard scores 33 as Blazers close strong in Milwaukee
games.story: The game had 20 lead changes and eight ties, and Portland's 13-0 run in the third quarter turned a 70-69 deficit into an 82-70 lead. Milwaukee tied it 108-108 with 5:33 left before the Trail Blazers went ahead for good, then closed the game on a 9-0 run from 115-114. Damian Lillard scored 33 points, Scoot Henderson added 27 on 5-of-6 3-point shooting, and Jrue Holiday had 22 points, seven assists and four steals. Tyler Herro led the Bucks with 19 points, and Nate Ament and Kasparas Jakučionis scored 18 each.

games.headline: Knicks hold off late Timberwolves rally in Minnesota
games.story: New York led 65-50 at halftime and went up 69-50 early in the third quarter. Minnesota trailed 97-85 with 7:56 left and outscored the Knicks 14-5 the rest of the way, but neither team scored after Ayo Dosunmu's 3-pointer made it 102-99 with 2:34 to go. Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 12 rebounds, and Jalen Brunson scored 21 with seven assists. Jonathan Kuminga led the Timberwolves with 23 points, and Minnesota was without Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo.

games.headline: Wembanyama scores 32 as Spurs pull away from Clippers
games.story: The game had nine lead changes and 10 ties, and the Clippers' biggest lead was six points in the third quarter. San Antonio broke a 95-95 tie with 10:15 left, never trailed again and won the fourth quarter 32-24. Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points, 12 assists and four steals, and Julian Champagnie scored 20. Brook Lopez made five 3-pointers and scored 23 for the Clippers, and Darius Garland also had 23.
